rules.name: VOICE_PROVIDER_NEUTRAL_CONTRACT_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: All providers MUST consume and produce FA3 provider-neutral voice artifacts.

rules.name: VOICE_PROVIDER_NOT_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: No provider may become voice identity, consent, policy, routing, resource, registry, workflow, session or evidence authority.

rules.name: VOICE_CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY_COUNT_INVARIANT
rules.requirement: The portfolio adds zero capabilities and zero authorities; capability count remains 143.

rules.name: VOICE_IMMUTABLE_RUNTIME_MODEL_PINS
rules.requirement: Runtime source and model identities MUST be immutable and digest/revision pinned.

rules.name: VOICE_ALLOWLIST_ONLY_MODEL_ADMISSION
rules.requirement: Only registry/admission-listed model identities may execute; arbitrary checkpoint paths are forbidden.

rules.name: VOICE_RUNTIME_NETWORK_FETCH_FORBIDDEN
rules.requirement: Inference MUST NOT download source, model or voice bytes; acquisition is an explicit bootstrap action.

rules.name: VOICE_RUNTIME_ENVIRONMENT_ISOLATION
rules.requirement: Each provider runtime MUST use an isolated environment outside ComfyUI and consuming application environments.

rules.name: VOICE_CENTRAL_GATEWAY_MEDIATION
rules.requirement: Clients MUST use the Central MCP/Capability Gateway and voice router rather than provider libraries as the canonical boundary.

rules.name: VOICE_HRB_ACCELERATOR_ADMISSION
rules.requirement: Accelerator execution MUST require a valid Host Resource Broker lease bound to stable device identity.

rules.name: VOICE_NO_SILENT_PROVIDER_MODEL_DEVICE_CLOUD_FALLBACK
rules.requirement: Provider, model, device, language and cloud fallback MUST be explicit, recorded and policy admitted.

rules.name: VOICE_HUNGARIAN_LANGUAGE_EXPLICIT
rules.requirement: Hungarian requests MUST carry explicit hu or hu-HU locale and pass provider language capability admission.

rules.name: VOICE_HUNGARIAN_CLONING_XTTS_PRIMARY_CANDIDATE
rules.requirement: XTTS-v2 is the primary Hungarian cloning candidate; this classification is not a runtime promotion claim.

rules.name: VOICE_HUNGARIAN_PIPER_CPU_FALLBACK
rules.requirement: Piper hu-HU is the lightweight CPU TTS fallback candidate and MUST NOT accept cloning requests.

rules.name: VOICE_VOXCPM_HUNGARIAN_DENIED
rules.requirement: VoxCPM2 Hungarian routing MUST fail closed while Hungarian is absent from its official supported-language list.

rules.name: VOICE_QWEN3_TTS_HUNGARIAN_DENIED
rules.requirement: Qwen3-TTS Hungarian routing MUST fail closed while Hungarian is absent from its official supported-language list.

rules.name: VOICE_COSYVOICE_HUNGARIAN_EXPERIMENTAL
rules.requirement: CosyVoice Hungarian remains experimental and cannot silently satisfy the production Hungarian baseline.

rules.name: VOICE_MMS_HUN_PRODUCTION_DENIED
rules.requirement: MMS-TTS-HUN is research/benchmark only and MUST NOT serve production or commercial requests under CC-BY-NC-4.0.

rules.name: VOICE_LICENSE_DIMENSIONS_SEPARATE
rules.requirement: Code, runtime, model, voice/dataset and output rights MUST be separately recorded and admitted.

rules.name: VOICE_LICENSE_ACCEPTANCE_AUDITABLE
rules.requirement: Model-license acceptance MUST be explicit, attributable and auditable when required.

rules.name: VOICE_CLONING_TYPED_CONSENT_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Human voice cloning MUST require typed GRANTED purpose-scoped consent including VOICE_SYNTHESIS and VOICE_CLONING.

rules.name: VOICE_CONSENT_EXPIRY_REVOCATION_CHECKED
rules.requirement: Consent expiry and revocation MUST be checked at admission and execution time.

rules.name: VOICE_REFERENCE_HASH_LINEAGE
rules.requirement: Reference audio and any reference transcript MUST be hash-bound to request, result and evidence.

rules.name: VOICE_REFERENCE_RETENTION_DELETION_POLICY
rules.requirement: Reference voice assets MUST carry authorized retention and deletion policy.

rules.name: VOICE_SYNTHETIC_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Generated speech MUST carry synthetic-audio disclosure metadata; impersonation, fraud and disinformation uses are forbidden.

rules.name: VOICE_HUNGARIAN_TEXT_NORMALIZATION
rules.requirement: Hungarian production requests MUST use tested normalization for numbers, dates, abbreviations, currency, names, diacritics and chunk boundaries.

rules.name: VOICE_HUNGARIAN_QUALITY_GATE
rules.requirement: hu-HU production promotion MUST include golden-corpus intelligibility, pronunciation, prosody and human-review evidence; cloning adds speaker-similarity evidence.

rules.name: VOICE_NATIVE_MASTER_PRESERVED
rules.requirement: Provider-native sample-rate master MUST be retained as a first-class artifact.

rules.name: VOICE_48KHZ_MEDIA_MEZZANINE_LINEAGE
rules.requirement: Media delivery uses explicit 48 kHz PCM projection; resampling produces a derived artifact with algorithm and hash lineage.

rules.name: VOICE_STREAMING_NOT_SESSION_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: Streaming is an execution projection and MUST NOT create provider-owned session semantics.

rules.name: VOICE_EVIDENCE_COMPLETE
rules.requirement: PASS evidence MUST bind request, route decision, provider/runtime/model, licenses, consent/reference, device/lease, native output, media projection and quality report.

rules.name: VOICE_CURRENT_HOST_PASS_NOT_DOCUMENT_DERIVED
rules.requirement: Canonical or CI reference PASS MUST NOT claim installed-provider, real-audio current-host or locale-quality PASS.

rules.name: VOICE_DISABLED_PROVIDER_ZERO_COST_NONBLOCKING
rules.requirement: Disabled optional providers MUST have zero or near-zero runtime cost and their absent runtime evidence MUST NOT block global promotion.
